Implement the Verilog module based on the following description. Assume that signals are positive clock/clk edge triggered unless otherwise stated.

Correct the syntax error in the code.

Reply with the complete corrected module in a ```verilog code block.

Problem Description:
The following is the state transition table for a Moore state machine with one input, one output, and four states. Implement this state machine. Include a synchronous active high reset that resets the FSM to state A. 
// State | Next state in=0, Next state in=1 | Output
// A | A, B | 0
// B | C, B | 0
// C | A, D | 0
// D | C, B | 1

module top_module (
	input clk,
	input in,
	input reset,
	output out
);

Erroneous Implementation:

always @(posedge clk) begin
	if (reset) begin
		state <= A;
	end
	else begin
		case (state)
			A: begin
				if (in) begin
					state <= B;
				end
			end
			B: begin
				if (in) begin
					state <= B;
				end
				else begin
					state <= C;
				end
			end
			C: begin
				if (in) begin
					state <= D;
				end
				else begin
					state <= A;
				end
			end
			D: begin
				if (in) begin
					state <= B;
				end
				else begin
					state <= C;
				end
			end
		endcase
	end
end
always @* begin
	if (state == D) begin
		out <= 1;
	end
	else begin
		out <= 0;
	end
end
endmodule
